title: Next earnings company-capture scorecards
status: Pre-release · company-issued guidance is the baseline
purpose: A compact checklist for the next reported periods. It asks whether each company is converting a plausible Wave-2 mechanism into durable revenue quality and cash economics; it does not rank companies, forecast results, or make an expectation-gap call.

companies.name: Elastic
companies.timing: Exact reporting date is pending Elastic's announcement.
companies.question: Can Elastic Cloud and agent-related workloads grow into durable consumption and retention without further cloud-hosting pressure on margins?

checks.title: Make cloud growth durable
checks.upgrade: Elastic Cloud growth and current RPO remain healthy, with evidence that usage or retention is durable rather than a one-quarter consumption spike.
checks.notEnough: A revenue-guide beat by itself. It establishes execution, not an agentic consumption mechanism.
checks.downgrade: Cloud growth or demand indicators slow materially while the cost-to-serve remains elevated.

checks.title: Show a paid agentic path
checks.upgrade: Management quantifies agent-related cloud usage, a paid capability, customer adoption, or a retention / pricing outcome tied to agentic search, retrieval, or investigation work.
checks.notEnough: An agent feature, technical demo, or customer anecdote without usage, pricing, or commercial adoption evidence.
checks.downgrade: Management indicates the relevant capabilities are bundled or immaterial, while no commercial KPI emerges.

checks.title: Protect the cash economics
checks.upgrade: Gross-margin, operating-margin, and cash-flow evidence shows that more cloud activity is becoming economically productive.
checks.notEnough: Higher cloud revenue without enough information about hosting costs, gross margin, or cash conversion.
checks.downgrade: Hosting costs accelerate faster than revenue and margin or free-cash-flow evidence deteriorates.

companies.boundary: Elastic does not separately disclose agent-specific revenue, usage, pricing, or retention. Keep a consumption mechanism separate from proven shareholder capture until a disclosed commercial KPI appears.

sources.label: Elastic Q1 FY2027 results and Q2 outlook

companies.name: Dynatrace
companies.timing: Exact reporting date is pending Dynatrace's announcement.
companies.question: Can rapidly growing logs consumption and AI observability become durable ARR and cash capture without acquisition or hosting costs eroding the economics?

checks.title: Convert telemetry volume into ARR
checks.upgrade: ARR and logs-consumption growth remain durable, with a clear link between higher telemetry demand and recurring paid usage or retention.
checks.notEnough: A large logs-consumption figure alone; it does not reveal the incremental revenue, margin, or cohort quality.
checks.downgrade: ARR growth slows, consumption weakens, or higher volume fails to produce attractive recurring economics.

checks.title: Show paid AI-observability adoption
checks.upgrade: Management discloses paid adoption, customer evidence, usage, or revenue contribution for AI observability, Autonomous SRE, Cloud SRE, Agent Building, or the Arize capability set.
checks.notEnough: A product announcement, acquisition rationale, or generic AI narrative without a commercial metric.
checks.downgrade: The company signals that AI observability is bundled, slow to adopt, or unable to monetize separately.

checks.title: Preserve margin and cash return
checks.upgrade: Operating and free-cash-flow performance supports the guided profile while hosting and acquisition effects remain controlled.
checks.notEnough: Top-line execution without clarity on margin dilution, integration costs, or cloud-hosting expense.
checks.downgrade: Acquisition or hosting costs materially dilute margins or cash returns without evidence of a compensating growth path.

companies.boundary: Dynatrace does not disclose agent-specific ARR, revenue, pricing, or retention cohorts. Logs growth and relevant products are mechanism evidence—not proof that the agentic thesis has been monetized.

sources.label: Dynatrace Q1 FY2027 results and Q2 outlook

companies.name: F5
companies.timing: Exact reporting date is pending F5's announcement.
companies.question: Can AI Gateway develop into a paid, recurring control-plane product rather than remain a relevant feature inside a systems-led growth quarter?

checks.title: Deliver the operating baseline
checks.upgrade: Q4 results meet or exceed the issued revenue and EPS ranges, with no deterioration in the underlying product or margin profile.
checks.notEnough: A guide beat alone; it establishes execution but not AI Gateway monetization.
checks.downgrade: A miss or reduced outlook tied to product demand, pricing, security spend, or margins.

checks.title: Make AI Gateway commercially visible
checks.upgrade: Management discloses paid customers, attach, pricing, recurring software contribution, usage, or a material pipeline-to-revenue bridge for AI Gateway or MCP governance.
checks.notEnough: A gateway launch, framework support, or customer story without commercial adoption evidence.
checks.downgrade: The relevant controls appear bundled, experimental, or commercially nonmaterial.

checks.title: Improve the revenue mix
checks.upgrade: Software, security, or recurring control-plane revenue gains traction alongside a healthy margin profile, rather than all growth coming from systems.
checks.notEnough: Strong product revenue if it is still predominantly hardware / systems-led with no recurring-control evidence.
checks.downgrade: Systems-led growth fades while software and recurring control-plane adoption remain slow or unreported.

companies.boundary: F5 has not disclosed AI Gateway revenue, customer count, pricing, attach rate, or usage. Product relevance is an early gate, not company capture.

sources.label: F5 Q3 FY2026 results and Q4 outlook

postReleaseProtocol: Record the actual results, guide changes, and management commentary from the earnings release and filing before making an interpretation.
Append the reported period to the company-capture history before replacing any current dashboard baseline.
Mark each check as evidence upgrade, unresolved, or contrary. Keep the counterargument visible and do not call an expectation gap without aligned consensus and valuation history.
